# Docs


- **Getting Started**
- [Installation](/docs/getting-started/installation): Download and install Gent on macOS, Windows, or Linux.
- [First Session](/docs/getting-started/first-session): Open your first terminal session and learn basic navigation in Gent.
- [Pairing Devices](/docs/getting-started/pairing-devices): Pair your phone or another computer with Gent over your local network.

- **Features**
- [Terminal](/docs/features/terminal): Full PTY terminal emulation with tabs, scrollback, and remote access.
- [Agent Chat](/docs/features/agent-chat): Chat with AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot inside Gent.
- [Gent Canvas](/docs/features/canvas): Render agent-generated HTML, charts, prototypes, and interactive web artifacts beside chat.
- [Gent Draw](/docs/features/draw): Sketch with Excalidraw, paste images, keep drawing history, export, and send one PNG to an agent.
- [IDE](/docs/features/ide): Built-in multi-file editor with file tree, git integration, and syntax highlighting.
- [Web Preview](/docs/features/web-preview): Preview localhost web apps from any paired device through a built-in reverse proxy.
- [File Transfer](/docs/features/file-transfer): Send and receive files between paired devices.
- [Projects](/docs/features/projects): Organize terminals, editors, and agent chats into project workspaces.
- [Orchestrator](/docs/features/orchestrator): Run multiple AI agents in parallel with the multi-agent orchestrator.
- [Voice Input](/docs/features/voice-input): Talk instead of type with built-in speech-to-text.

- **Integrations**
- [Integrations Overview](/docs/integrations/overview): How MCP connectors work in Gent and what they enable.
- [Connector Setup](/docs/integrations/connector-setup): How to install and configure an MCP connector in Gent.
- [Connector List](/docs/integrations/connector-list): All MCP connectors available in Gent, organized by category.
- [Gent Forge](/docs/integrations/mate-forge): Type /connect anything and let an agent generate a custom MCP server for a product, API, website, or workflow.
- [Agentic Mobile](/docs/integrations/argent): An agentic toolkit to control, debug, and profile iOS and Android applications through the bundled Argent connector.
- [Claude Code Integration](/docs/integrations/claude-code): How Claude Code CLI works inside Gent's agent chat.
- [Custom Connectors](/docs/integrations/custom-connectors): Add your own MCP servers as connectors in Gent.
- [Custom Adapters](/docs/integrations/custom-adapters): Add support for a new AI coding CLI by writing a declarative adapter — no app build required.
- [Skills](/docs/integrations/skills): Extend your AI agents with installable skills.

- **Remote**
- [Remote Sessions](/docs/remote/overview): How remote access works in Gent — your desktop is the server, other devices are mirrors.
- [Mobile Usage](/docs/remote/mobile): Using Gent from your iPhone or Android device.
- [Remote Troubleshooting](/docs/remote/troubleshooting): Common remote connection issues and how to fix them.

- **Reference**
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](/docs/reference/keyboard-shortcuts): Common keyboard shortcuts for Gent on desktop.
- [Settings](/docs/reference/settings): App settings reference for Gent.
